name: literature_review
description: Literature review is a cross-domain research-synthesis workflow primitive for systematic searches, screening, extraction, quality appraisal, citation verification, and review assembly. Use it for systematic reviews, scoping reviews, meta-analysis preparation, evidence synthesis, and research-gap mapping.
capabilities: Plan reproducible multi-database literature searches with recorded search strings and dates.
Define inclusion, exclusion, screening, extraction, and quality-appraisal steps.
Track citation verification and synthesis structure.
Hand off visual, citation, database, and document-generation needs to specialized primitives.
requirements: Review question, scope, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and target output type.
Citation verification and screening records for systematic work.
